description: Run the locked behaviours (the commands that prove existing features still work). Run before reporting a task as done. If one fails, fix your change; never edit the test or weaken the check. Snapshot locks compare output with an approved copy: never edit .stet/snapshots/ or approve a new snapshot yourself; tell the human.

only.description: Lock IDs to run, e.g. ["L2"]. Default: all.

name: stet_check
